normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-001:ab68c1: WHEN Hopper_Level_High has been continuously true and the plant has run continuously for the persistence threshold time THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is asserted
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-001:8ea7f6: WHEN Hopper_Level_High has been continuously true and the plant has run continuously for the persistence threshold time THEN the inhibit/stop demand output is asserted
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-001:0772fa: WHEN Hopper_Level_High is continuously true for longer than the persistence threshold while neither Shredder_Run_Fwd_FB nor Shredder_Run_Rev_FB is true and no hopper-blockage alarm was previously latched THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is not asserted
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-001:2bdfa7: WHEN the plant's running feedback is lost part-way through the persistence window and later returns with Hopper_Level_High still continuously true THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is asserted once the cumulative high-and-running time reaches the persistence threshold
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-002:efe6b5: WHEN Hopper_Level_High goes false and stays continuously false for at least the clear-debounce filter time before the accumulated persistence time reaches the threshold THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is not raised for that high episode
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-002:bfda9d: WHEN Hopper_Level_High reads false for less than the clear-debounce filter time before the accumulated persistence time reaches the threshold THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is still raised for that high episode
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-003:607fdf: WHEN Hopper_Level_High goes false for at least the clear-debounce filter time while the plant is running and then returns true THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is not asserted until a further full persistence threshold of high-and-running time has accumulated
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-003:652dd6: WHEN Hopper_Level_High goes false for less than the clear-debounce filter time while the plant is running and then returns true THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is asserted once the persistence threshold measured from before the brief clear has accumulated
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-003:aa1d87: WHEN Hopper_Level_High goes false for at least the clear-debounce filter time while the plant is stopped and the plant then restarts with the hopper high THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is not asserted until a further full persistence threshold of high-and-running time has accumulated
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-003:09e3a8: WHEN Hopper_Level_High reads false for less than the clear-debounce filter time while the plant is stopped and then returns true THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is asserted once the persistence threshold measured from before that brief false has accumulated
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-004:14c9b6: NEVER the hopper-blockage alarm de-asserts unless FaultReset has been asserted since the alarm was raised
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-005:0463ce: WHEN a rising edge of FaultReset occurs while the hopper-blockage alarm is latched and the accumulated persistence time is below the threshold THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is false when next observed and stays false
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-005:7e39bc: WHEN a rising edge of FaultReset occurs while the hopper-blockage alarm is latched and the accumulated persistence time is below the threshold THEN the inhibit/stop demand output is false when next observed and stays false
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-005:179eb7: WHEN a rising edge of FaultReset occurs while the plant is running and the accumulated persistence time is still at or past the threshold THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is true when next observed
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-005:6e1e8d: NEVER the hopper-blockage alarm is held de-asserted by a continuously-true FaultReset while the accumulated persistence time is at or past the threshold
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-005:34fd97: WHEN a rising edge of FaultReset occurs in the same evaluation in which the accumulated persistence time first reaches the threshold THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is true when next observed
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-005:e7e0e0: WHEN a rising edge of FaultReset occurs while the plant is stopped and the accumulated persistence time is at or past the threshold THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is true when next observed
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-006:469954: WHEN Hopper_Level_High returns false while the hopper-blockage alarm is latched and FaultReset is not asserted THEN the hopper-blockage alarm remains asserted
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-007:4197e0: WHEN the PLC powers up with no hopper-blockage alarm latched THEN a hopper-blockage alarm requires a full persistence threshold of high-and-running time accumulated after power-up
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-007:7edf6c: WHEN the PLC powers up with the hopper-blockage alarm latched from before the power cycle THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is asserted after power-up
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-007:578675: WHEN the PLC powers up with the hopper-blockage alarm latched from before the power cycle THEN the inhibit/stop demand output is asserted after power-up
normalisedTexts.REQ-HBA-007:9855c5: WHEN a rising edge of FaultReset occurs after a power cycle while the hopper is still blocked THEN the hopper-blockage alarm is false when next observed
